10.label: Beadle van
10.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Slot them into a verb to help. Thorough: Finds one more thing at every scene.

12.label: Burglary at the van der Meer House
12.desc: No broken glass at Grete Fuller's. Whoever came in during the dinner hour used the stair from the rooms above, and left with three watches and a ledger. A neighbour reports seeing nothing at all, which is the strange part. (Patricians' Hill)

15.label: Bess Schmidt
15.desc: Bess Schmidt, the owner's partner in trade. Drives a dray with a lame grey mule. (Accused in: Burglary at the van der Meer House)

25.label: Beadle Kuiper
25.desc: A parish beadle with a staff and a loud voice. Knocks on doors without complaining and whips beggars without being asked. Slot them into a verb to help. Steady: Working beside them, you do not tire.

30.label: Trijn Visscher
30.desc: Trijn Visscher, a nephew of the house. Never takes off a heavy gold signet. (Accused in: Burglary at the van der Meer House)

34.label: Jörg Pfister
34.desc: Jörg Pfister, the night porter. Has ink-black fingers; works a printer's press. (Accused in: Burglary at the van der Meer House)

40.label: False Coin in the Cattle Market
40.desc: Somebody in the city has a furnace going on Sunday, when the forges are cold: a smell of hot metal in a lane of weavers. The Mintmaster is certain of the die. In a midden nearby, a broken mould. (The Harbour)

47.label: Endres Sattler
47.desc: Endres Sattler, a moneychanger. Wears great hobnailed boots, a soldier's. (Accused in: False Coin in the Cattle Market)

50.label: Protection in the Night Market
50.desc: Stallholders around the Night Market have been paying for "protection" every market day, collected by a cart that stands outside until it is paid. Lijsbet Tanner refused, and lost their awning. Somewhere there is a receipt book. (The Stews)

58.label: Anneke Kuiper
58.desc: Anneke Kuiper, a sergeant of the Watch. Drives a dray with a lame grey mule. (Accused in: Protection in the Night Market)

77.label: Witness: Rafe Kessler
77.desc: Rafe Kessler, the night-watchman crying the hours. Saw something near the van der Meer House, and has no stake in it that you can see. (Witness in: Burglary at the van der Meer House)

80.label: Witness: Lijsbet Imhoff
80.desc: Lijsbet Imhoff, the woman who keeps the cookshop. Saw something near the Night Market, and has heard there is a reward. (Witness in: Protection in the Night Market)

91.label: Band: The Kings of the Warrens
91.desc: Sworn together by Sworn C0, Sworn C1, Sworn C2, who all walked from you. They feed the Vendetta every week. Go in Disguise to build a case against them.

result.label: The Coin Assayed
result.text: The apothecary's acid finds lead under the silver, and the same flaw in the Emperor's eye on every piece. One die.

journal.title: They Found Each Other
journal.text: Sworn C0, Sworn C1, Sworn C2: every one of them walked away from one of your cases. Now they drink in the same cellar, and call themselves the Kings of the Warrens.

journal.title: Week 11
journal.text: Lodging and dues take 2. The Council's stipend: 1 Coin. Lucia Brenner paid a witness of yours to forget. There is a purse on your desk. Nobody saw who left it. The ledger: no case closed; 3 open; 9 Coin in hand.

journal.title: A Witness Paid to Forget
journal.text: Witness: Rafe Kessler has had a visit and a purse from Lucia Brenner, and is suddenly leaving the city. Half a minute, if you want their word.

journal.text: Lucia Brenner has the Provost's letter and a desk on the other side of the Market. They will work your cases from the other side: close them first, spoil your scenes, pay your witnesses to forget. Question them, buy them, frighten them, or shadow them; find their weakness twice and the Council sends them home.

journal.title: Back at the Scene
journal.text: The night-watchman keeps his hours in his head. Two, quiet. Three, the shutter open. Somebody knew the house, and somebody was in and out between the bells. The back room stayed locked, and the hard way in wore you out.

journal.title: The Round
journal.text: Two drunks, a stolen goose and a lost dog. The dog was the most reasonable of them. Your feet ache all the way up to your skull.

journal.title: Sleep
journal.text: You sleep from vespers to terce and wake up hungry. The world is still there. So are you.

journal.title: Partial Results
journal.text: Without a Physician's Case, you only get part of it. The blade was a chisel, chipped at one corner. Find the chisel, find the burglar. You worked into the dark, and it cost you.

journal.title: At the Scene
journal.text: You go in past the beadle at the van der Meer House. The back shutter has been forced with something flat and patient, and the strongbox stands open like a mouth. You come away with The Pried Shutter, The Inventory. A name for the board: Bess Schmidt. The back room stayed locked, and the hard way in wore you out.

journal.title: The Letter of Appointment
journal.text: The Council's seal is still warm on the letter that makes you Examiner. The Burgomaster's chamber is up one flight and has a window; yours is under the stair and has a case on it already. Everyone in the Watch-house knows which one you are looking at.
